tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ba su dhā rā sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan yang

dpal gyi 'byor pa chen po thob pa'i phyir/ nor rgyun ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ de la sgrub pa pos sems bskyed la/ snying gar pad zla'i steng du bam̐/ de'i 'od kyis rten spyan drangs te tshogs gnyis gsog pa sngon sgrub thabs rnams su ji skad bstan pa bzhin du thams cad de ltar bya'o// 'on kyang dngos gzhi khyad par pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du ā li sde tshan dang por bgrang ba'i sde tshan drug pa pa sde 'i gsum pa ba 'i sa bon zla phyed dang thig les brgyan pa ste bam̐ ser po'o/ de nyid las 'phros 'dus yongs su rdzogs pa'i nor rgyun ma mdog ser ba/ 'bras kyi snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i bum pa ni g.yon pa'i phyag na'o// g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dzam+bha la dang dpal chen mo sogs mdza' ba'i skye 'gro rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba bsgom par bya'o/ /lha sku'i gsal snang la yun ring du sems bzung nas bdag nyid nor rgyun ma zhes nga rgyal bsgom par bya'o/ /gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa'i slad lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcings te gung mo gnyis kyi tshigs gsum pa bcag pa nor bu 'dra bar byas pa ni nor rgyun ma'i phyag rgya'o// de nas bsgoms pas skyon sngags bzlas pa bya ste/ oṃ shrī ba su ni dhā na k+ṣe tre swā hā/ bzlas zin nas thang sku'i 'dun sar bcom ldan 'das ma la mchod pa chen po byas nas bskum zhing nyal bar bya'o// des bcom ldan 'das ma 'grub par 'gyur ro/ nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong ba ri rin chen grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ ba su dhā ra dhā ra ṇī u pa de sha /bod skad du/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi man ngag

'phags ma nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten dang nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa las gsungs pa'i bris sku'am sngar ji skad bstan pa'i mngon rtogs ltar gyi sku gzugs bkram nas de'i mdun du tsan+dan dkar po gyi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa byas nas/ de nas mngon rtogs gang yang rung bas bcom ldan 'das ma bskyed nas nye bar spyod pa ci 'byor pas mchod cing lag pa tsan+dan gyis byugs te nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi pusti gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pas bcings nas slar yang me tog gi phreng bas bcings te mdun du chu'i snod bzhag nas nang du gzugs brnyan 'char bar byas nas bcug ste/ sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems kyis dmigs te dngos grub mngon par 'dod pas gzungs kyi puste snying gar bzung ste nor rgyun ma'i gzungs bklag par bya'o// klog pa yang gzungs kyi na mo nas dbu bzung ste mthar swā hā dang ldan pas yang nas yang du klog ste/ sngags rnams kyi swā hā zhes pa'i sgra brjod pa na/ me tog dkar po dūr+wa dang bcas te ka ra dang 'bras dag chu'i snod du gus pas dngos grub gsol ba'i yid kyis dbul bar bya'o/ /khrus dang gtsang sbra dang smyung bar gnas pas gos dang phyogs gtsang mar ji srid zla ba drug bklag cing mchod yon gyi snod kyi chus phyogs thams cad du 'thor zhing lhag ma rgya mtshor 'babs pa'i chu'i nang du gshegs par bya'o// nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi man ngag sgrub pa'i thabs rgya mtsho las byung ba rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta kīrti tsan+d+ra dang yar klung lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha siṃ hā ya/ gur nas gsungs pa'i nor rgyun ma bsgom par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra/

rang skad cig gis lha mo nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma'i steng du bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo nor rgyun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ba su dhā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs dang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ rang gi phung khams bskyed mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mdza' ba'i skye 'gro rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/

sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ oṃ shrī ba su ni dhā na k+ṣe tre swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla'o// bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis sogs brjod/ 'di'i rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ tshom bu'i mthar mchod gtor sogs bsham pa dang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs bdag bskyed gong ltar bya/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sogs yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ oṃ ba su dhā rā sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ phun tshogs dge legs sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pas dbul/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa dang bcas pa rnams lan gsum dang*/ gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob ma la bskyed bstim bya/ rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ dam bca' ba spyi dang mthun/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir du rigs 'dra bstim/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ rjes mchod bstod byas la/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gnas gsum bsrungs la bsngo ba dang bkra shis bya'o// yang na sgrub thabs rgya mtsho ltar bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni rang gi dran pa gso phyir du brang btsun ga ga na shrī bha dras sbyar ba'o//

༈ /nor rgyun ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa 'dod rgu'i sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'phags ma gang mtshan 'dzin tsam gyis// nor gyi rgyun 'bebs lha mo la// btud nas de yi sgrub rjes dang*// las tshogs 'dod rgu'i sprin phung dbye// 'di la gsum/ sgrub pa'i thabs/ rjes gnang gi cho ga las kyi tshogs mdo tsam bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ mngon rtogs spyir bstan pa dang*/ bsnyen thabs bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa'i sgrub pa pos/ gnas dben par bde ba'i gdan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod de/ sems can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi rgud pa thams cad bsal nas phan pa dang bde ba'i 'byor pa zad mi shes pa la dgod par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam rtse gcig pas kun nas bslangs te mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul rnams mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/

rang skad cig gis lha mo nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bam̐ yig gser btso ma'i mdog can/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo nor rgyun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ ba su dhā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum gyis rgyud sbyangs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba thams cad stong par sbyangs te ye shes kyi tshogs la mnyam par gzhag stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig gser btso ma'i mdog can/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal te/ dpal 'byor gyi bde bas tshim pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ mchod yul rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i gter chen po'i bum pa bzang po bsnams pa/ dar sngon po'i sha 'gag dkar po'i stod g.yogs/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i smad g.yogs rnams dang nor bu rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dzam+bha la dang dpal chen mo sogs mdza' ba'i skye 'gro yid 'phrog pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig ser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs ye shes pa spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa bya/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ lha sku'i gsal snang la yun ring du sems gzung*/ des skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad la dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal te 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par byas/ mchod yul rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad dang*/ brtan g.yo'i dpal 'byor dwangs bcud ma lus pa 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te snying ga'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas dngos grub thams cad thob par bsams la/ oṃ shrī ba su ni dhā na k+ṣe tre swā hā/ zhes yi ge bcu gcig pa'i sngags myur ba dang bul ba la sogs pa'i skyon spangs te rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis bzla/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la chos mthun gyi 'byor pa zad mi shes pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes brjod cing bsams la gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nor rgyun lha mo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog

/ces dang*/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa zhes sogs bsngo smon shis brjod kyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ dben zhing yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i bsam gtan gyi khang bur phyag dar legs par bya/ 'byor na 'di nyid kyi sku brnyan bris 'bur gang rigs bsham/ gang ltar yang 'bul gtor dkar zlum shing tog dang dkar gsum sogs zas sna gtsang mas gtams pa dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril gyis mtshon dgos pa'i yo byad rnams bkod mdzes su bstar/ khrus dang gtsang sbra'i kun spyod la gnas pas mtshams dam par bcad la thun bzhi la sogs par mngon rtogs ji skad bshad pa bzhin bsgom/ sngags 'bum phrag bcu gcig kha skong khri phrag bcu gcig sogs bzla/ spro zhing nus na de nyid bzhi 'gyur ram brgyad 'gyur du bzla bar bshad pas/ 'bum phrag bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi 'am/ brgyad cu rtsa brgyad kha skong dang bcas pa bzla ba ni bsnyen sgrub chab cig pa yin/ thun gnyis sam snga thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma dbul bar bya ste/ gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim zhes pa'i rjes su/ gtor mar chab bran te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis brlab/ gtor mgron ni rgyas par spro na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma sogs nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor zhing*/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba zhes bsgyur/ mi nus na/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/

oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ gang ltar yang sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ oṃ shrī ba su dhā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma// dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma// bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa zad mi shes pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod na 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ gnas gsum bsrung ba dang bsngo smon bkra shis gong ltar bya/ thun mtshams rnams su nor rgyun ma'i gzungs klog pa dang*/ mchod sbyin sogs tshogs sgo du ma nas bsag gzhan mtshams kyi spang blang spyi ltar shes par byas la nyams su blangs shing*/ grub na kha skong gi don du zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kyang bya'o// gnyis pa rjes gnang la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ stegs bu'i dbus su mañdzi'i khar maṇ+ḍa lar dri bzang gi thig le byas la me tog gi tshom bu gcig dgod/ de'i mdun du 'bul gtor dang*/ byang shar nas brtsams te mtshams 'dzin me tog dang chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas skor du bsham/ gzhan yang dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klus par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis brlab/ dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum gyis byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung bzlas pa'i rjes kyi gsol ba 'debs pa bdag bskyed gong ltar bya/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sogs nas/ dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba zhes pa'i tshab tu 'di la zhes bsgyur/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ shrī ba su dhā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab pa gong ltar dang*/ sngags mthar a kā ro btags pa gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar dmigs la bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral du 'khod par me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshe ring de bzhin nad med dang*// gzugs dang skal ba bzang dang rigs// nor dang shes rab dag dang bdun// yon tan bdun ces thub pas gsungs// zhes mtho ris kyi 'byor pa'i mthar thug pa yon tan bdun ces bsngags pa'i rgyan gcig pu/ lha chos dang mi chos mtha' dag gi mthun rkyen/ khyad par du rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa mchog la gzhol ba rnams kyi bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi ya gyal sbyin pa rnam pa gsum du phye ba'i nang gses zang zing gi sbyin pa dang*/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i gzhir gyur cing*/ rdzas las byung ba'i bsod nams bdun gyi nyer len med du mi rung ba ni nor gyi 'byor pa nyid yin la/

de sgrub pa'i thabs kyang rgyu'i theg par dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ dbul phongs la sbyin pa gtong ba sogs bgyis na rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i phyir longs spyod khyad par can mthong ba'i chos la 'thob par gsungs pas mtshon rgya che ba'i thabs ji snyed cig bstan cing*/ de dag las ches khyad par 'phags pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas gnod sbyin nor lha'i sgrub pa'i thabs rab 'byams la brten nas gnas skabs su chos mthun gyi 'byor pa nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' bsgyur bas bstan pa dang*/ sems can gyi phan bde mtha' yas pa sgrub pa dang*/ mthar thug 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang dka' ba med par sgrub pa'i thabs zab mo rmad du byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud chen por/ nor gyi blo gros chen po 'di// de ltar sngags pas bsgom na des// dpag tshad bdun ni rgyas par yang*// nor gyi char gyis khyab par mdzod// ces dang*/ bcom ldan nor rgyun zhes bya ba'i// mtshan ni mi mchog sgrogs bgyid na// de la nor gyi rgyun 'bebs shing*// nor chen dang ni ldan par bgyi// zhes sku'i snang brnyan bsgom pa dang*/ mtshan 'dzin pa tsam la'ang 'dod rgu'i dbyig gi char chen po 'bebs par bsngags pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma la rgyud sde chen po bzhi nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo dang*/ 'khor gyi tshul du bstan pa'i sgrub thabs mang du gsungs pa las/ 'dir ni 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ bam̐ gyi yi ge las byung ba// nor 'dzin shin tu kha dog ser// lag pa mchog sbyin 'bras snye ma// rdo rje skyil krung sbyor ba las// yan lag rin chen 'byung gnas brgyan// spyan ni shin tu sgeg pa ni// gnod sbyin rgyal mo bsgom par bya// nor gyi bdag mo nges par 'grub// ces gsungs pa sogs la brten nas/

paṇa grub dbang po rdo rje gdan pas legs par bkral zhing rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa'i 'phags ma nor rgyun ma ser mo'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo bsgrub pa la zhes sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal dbul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs rgyun bshags bya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams lan gsum dang*/ gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob ma lha mor bskyed/ gnas gsum byin brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ rjes su bzlas pa lan gsum dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ dam bca' ba spyi dang mthun/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir rigs 'dra bstim pa bcas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang gi chings sbyar/ rjes dam tshig khas blang sogs spyi ltar bya/ gsum pa ni/ mchod pa byin brlab/ gtang rag gi mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon bkra shis bya'o// gsum pa las tshogs mdo tsam bshad pa la gsum/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gzungs kyi cho ga gter bum bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ 'das pa'i me lha'i bskyed chog dang sngags kyi 'byin 'jug gtso bor gyur pa'i khyad par gyi chos 'ga' zhig ma gtogs kye rdor gyi rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ji lta ba ste/ de'ang thab kyi dbus su phyag mtshan nam tshon phung ser po bya/ mchod pa bshams pa dang byin rlabs/ 'bul ba bcas kyi skabs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kho nas mthus/ nang mchod dang*/ rdzas la bdud rtsi lngas gtor ba sogs mi dgos/ bsang chu la a mṛ tas brlab/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas byin rlabs skabs/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba sogs sbyar/

me lha gong 'og gi skye mched byin rlabs mi dgos/ gnas gsum byin rlabs kyis 'thus/ gau rī ā kar+ṣa sogs mi dgos/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ 'das pa'i me lha'i bsreg rdzas rdzogs skabs mchod bstod rgyas par spro na 'og tu gzungs mchog skabs 'byung ba ltar sbyar/ gtor ma gong ltar phul bas mtshon khyad chos phra mo rnams ma 'dres par bya/ yang na gsang ba spyi'i lugs kyi rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga yang rung bas khog dbub kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang 'das pa'i me lha'i skabs su lha mo yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa dang*/ sngags yi ge bcu gcig pa dang spel tshig bdag gam sbyin pa'i bdag po'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes dang*/ rdzas gtso bo zho zan la mngar gsum sbyar ba'i zas mchog dang*/ gur gum la sogs pa'i kha dog ser zhing dri bsung rgyas pa'i sman gyi me tog dngos sam/ ma 'byor na 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru gur gum gyis kha bsgyur ba la grangs bzung ste 'bum phrag la sogs pa dang*/ rdzas gzhan brgya rtsa brgyad las mi nyung ba phul bas dngos grub myur du 'thob pa'i tshul/ 'bar ba tshim pas lha mnyes shing*// dngos grub ma lus myur du 'grub// tshe dang dbang phyug phun tshogs shing*// 'byor pa chen po 'thob par 'gyur// ces sogs rgya cher gsungs so// de bzhin du bsnyen sgrub kha skong gi don gyi phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par spro na'ang*/ gong du smos pa ltar kye rdor ram/ gsang ba spyi'i lugs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la kha bsgyur zhing rdzas til dang*/ sngags bcu cha sogs ji ltar nus pa phul bas lhag chad kha bskang zhing las myur du 'grub pa'i tshul dpal kha sbyor las/ sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshim// tshim par gyur nas dngos grub stsol// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /de kun sbyin sreg gis ni dgang*// zhes so// gzhan yang rtog pa las/
til gyi sbyin sreg brgyad brgya byas na rgyal rigs las rnyed pas chen po thob bo// yungs kar mar la bsres nas sbyin sreg byas na rgyal po dbang du byed do// kun

sa gsher can zhes bya ba'i shing dri bzang po can zhig ste/ ma rnyed na bal bu'i me tog gis tshab rung*/ du ra'i sbyin sreg byas na blon po dbang du byed do// zhes gsungs pa'ang ji ltar rigs pa nyams su blang ngo*// gnyis pa la gsum/ bris sku 'bri tshul/ gzungs chog dngos/ de'i phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'grub tu rung na chur khru bdun zheng du khru gsum pa'i ras gzhi'am/ yang na zheng du mtho gang*/ srid du mtho do'i tshad kyi ras gzhi la lha bzo gso sbyong dang ldan pas/ dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la lha mo nor rgyun ma sogs nas/ steng gi nam mkhar lha'i bu rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'i tshogs kyi bar 'og gi mngon rtogs nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ 'og tu sgrub pa po pus mo btsugs shing*/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog thogs nas bcom ldan 'das ma la rtse gcig tu blta ba gus pa'i ngang tshul can bri/ rab tu gnas pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas mnga' dbul bar bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i sgrub pa pos/ dpyid zla ra ba sogs shis pa'i dus su tshes gcig gi sngar nyin gnas khang phyag dar bya/ dri zhim po'i chus chag chag gdab/ ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten dang*/ bris sku zhal nub tu phyogs nas bkram pa'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa tsan+dan dkar pos byugs shing me tog sil ma dgram pa dang*/ gtor ma dkar zlum dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rnams bsham/ de dang nye ba'i rang gi mdun du rin po che'i snod rgyun 'bab kyi chus bkang ba'i nang du bris sku'i gzugs brnyan 'char bar bya/ de'i dbus su mañtsi'i khar 'di nyid kyi gzungs mdo'i glegs bam chung ngu na bza' dang bcas gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa dang me tog gi phreng bas bcings pa bzhugs/

rang gi mdun du rin po che'i snod du me tog dkar po/ dūrba/ ka ra/ 'bras dang bcas pa sbyar ba'i mchod pa dang*/ gzhan yang rdor dril sogs ji ltar dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ tshes gcig gi nangs par snga bar langs te/ theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blang*/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas skyabs 'gro nas bzung bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa gdan bsdu ba'i bar sngon du 'gro bas mdun gyi bris sku la dmigs te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar yid 'phrog pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'khrigs pa'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ljang ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhi zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas pa na 'bras bu chen po dang*/ g.yon na sgrub pa po rnams la ster ba'i rin po che'i za ma tog mu tig dang*/ rdo rje pha lam dang bai ḍūr+ya'i 'bras bu can bsnams pa/ dar sngon po'i sham kag dang*/ dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i sham thabs mnabs pa/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa rgya mtsho'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon khu tshur brlar bzhag pa/ de'i g.yas su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dmar gsal/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon rol pa'i tshul gyis gdan la bsten pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang sngon cung zad khros pa'i nyams can/ g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon rol pa'i tshul can/ gsum ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ lha mo'i g.yas logs su dpal chen mo pad+ma'i phyag can sgrub pa po la nye bar dgongs bzhin pa/

g.yon du pad+ma'i dpal phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i snyim pa rin po ches gang ba/ gnyis ka'ang sku mdog dmar ser dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhabs sems ma'i skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ steng gi nam mkhar lha'i bu rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'i tshogs dang*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa/ mtha' skor kun tu dzam+bha la dang dpal chen mo sogs mdza' ba'i skye 'gro yid 'phrog pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig ser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim pa'i mos pa bya/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa kun// 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī ba su dhā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil dang*/ pā d+yaṃ/ me tog dang*/ puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang*/ dhū pe/ mar me dang*/ ā lo ke/ dri mchog dang*/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ya/

rol mo dang*/ shab+da'i bar sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ spro na 'dod yon lnga/ rin chen bdun/ gos zung rnams spyi ltar dbul/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma'am so bdun ma dkyus bzhin la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la chos mthun gyi 'byor pa zad mi shes pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes sbyar/ bstod pa ni rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung sogs bris sku dang mthun pa'i bstod pa rgyas pas bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba'i skabs su thal mo sbyar zhing me tog 'thor/ de nas sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems kyis dmigs nas dngos grub mngon par 'dod pa'i yid kyis gzungs kyi glegs bam snying gar bzung ste/ gleng gzhi nas brtsams te/ oṃ ba su swā hā zhes pa'i bar gsal ngag snyan pa'i ngag gis bklag swā hā zhes pa'i sngags rnams brjod pa dang lhan cig tu dpal gyi 'byor pa chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol snyam pas me tog dkar po sogs kyi mchod pa chu snod du dbul ba re bya/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis gzungs kho na ji tsam nus pa bzla/ thun las ldang ba na mjug tu gzungs kyi phan yon sogs rdzogs par bton te glegs bam sngar bzhin bzhugs su gsol/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ shrī ba su dhā rā sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma dbul/ oṃ shrī ba su dhā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar sbyar bas mchod/

phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma// dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma// bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces dang*/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa zad mi shes pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ gtang rag gi mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mas sogs 'dod don gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs nas/ badz+rā ya swā hā zhes brtan bzhugs bya zhing me tog 'thor/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nor rgyun lha mo 'grub gyur sogs bsngo smon dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs kyis mtshon/ mdo rgyud las byung ba'i shis brjod rgyas par byas nas thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug thun bar sogs su sher phyin sogs kyi mdo bklag pa/ sāts+tsha gdab pa/ chu gtor gtang ba sogs rang ngam gzhan gyis gang 'grub bya/ de lta bu'i rim pas zla ba drug gam/ zla gcig gam/ zhag bdun nam/ tha na'ang nyin zhag gcig sogs ji ltar rigs pa rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis 'bad pas rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur ro// de yang nyin dang mtshan du thun bcad la 'bad cing*/ khyad par tshes brgyad dang bco lnga lta bu'i dus bzang rnams su mtshan thog thag tu bzlas pa bgyis na gzhung nas gsungs pa dang mthun pas shin tu legs/ gsum pa ni/ cho ga rdzogs pa na/ bris sku mdzod kyi phug tu bzhugs te dus dang rgyun du mchod/

zhing rmo ba'i tshe zhing gi dbus su spyan drangs la bcom ldan 'das mar bskyed cing mchod bstod bzlas pa bya/ gtor ma dbul/ bum pa'i chu sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pas zhing rmo mkhan sogs dang*/ sa bon la gtor/ chu rgyun gyis zhing la g.yas skor du bya/ de lta bu'i rim pas btsas ma brnga ba dang*/ g.yul 'chag pa dang*/ 'bru mdzod du gzhug pa sogs kyi tshe'ang cho ga ji ltar rigs pa bya ba'i tshul rtog pa las shes/ gzungs kyi glegs bam rin po che'am rdza'i ga'ur rin chen 'bru sman dar zab sogs dang lhan cig par bcug la bang mdzod kyi dbus su bkur sti dang bcas te bzhugs shing dus dus su bklag mchod yon phul ba'i chus khyim thams cad dang*/ phyugs kyi rwa ba dang*/ zhing dang*/ skyed mo'i tshal sogs su gtor/ rang gzhan gyis btung*/ sa bon gdab bya'i 'bru la'ang khyab par bran/ lhag ma rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// gsum pa de ltar brtson pa'i phan yon ni/ gzungs las/ rigs kyi bu su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa byas te/ nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag nub gcig bton na/ de nas dngos grub tu 'gyur ro// rgyas pa'i don du bdag gi khyim mam/ gzhan gyi khyim mam/ gnas gtsang ma bang mdzod dam/ gnas gang yang rung bar de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lha'i phyir tsan+dan gyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas te/ nub gcig bton na/ rigs kyi bu de'i khyim nor bu dang*/ 'bru dang*/ gser dngul dang*/ yo byad thams cad kyi rgyun mi chen po'i tshad tsam gyis gang bar 'gyur ro// 'jigs pa dang gnod pa thams cad kyang med par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ rtog pa las/ stan gcig la gnas te bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhal la dmigs la nub mo mtshan thog thag tu bzlas pa byas na/

de nas skya rengs shar ba'i dus su skyes bu chen po tsam gyi nor rin po che thams cad kyi rgyun 'bab cing khang pa gang bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ zla ba gcig gi sbyor bas nor gyi rgyun 'bab par 'gyur te/ mi shes pa kha gcig 'phel bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ cho ga 'dis cho 'phrul gyi dkar po'i phyogs la bzlas pa byas na 'khor los sgyur ba thob cing bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma dngos su mthong zhing phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'gyur ro// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar ro// yang rgya gzhung las/ nor rgyun ma'i bris sku'am gzugs dgram zhes gsungs pas/ gong du smos pa'i bris sku 'bri ba ma grub na/ gtso rkyang gi sku bris 'bur gang rung bsham/ de'ang ma grub na tshom bu tsam la brten na'ang rung bas/ de'i tshe mdun bskyed gsal gdab skabs gong du rjes gnang sogs kyi skabs su smos pa ltar gtso rkyang mdun bskyed ltar gsal gdab cing*/ gzhan mchod bstod gzungs bzla ba sogs ji skad bshad pa bzhin bgyis pas kyang rung la/ tshom bu tsam la brten pa'i skabs mjug tu ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bstim pa'am/ rin po che dang bang mdzod sogs kyi rten la bzhugs su gsol bas kyang rung bar gsungs so// gsum pa gter bum sgrub pa'i tshul la/ rin po che'am rdza'i bum pa bre gang shong ba las mi chung ba'i nang du bum rdzas nyer lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i rin chen 'bru sman dar zab dkar mngar sogs kyi phud gtsang zhing skyon dang bral bas legs par bkang ba'i dbus su 'byor na gtso mo'i bris sku dang*/ gang ltar yang rab gzungs kyi cho ga byas pa'i glegs bam/ de min gzungs tshang ba'am/ rtsa sngags yi ge bcu gcig pa dang*/ gzungs sngags dngos gzhi'i mthar/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor mthun rkyen legs tshogs thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/

zhes sogs 'dod gsol rgyas bsdus gang rigs sbyar ba gzhug slar yang kha rin chen 'bru sman spos phye sogs dang 'jim pas gcad cing dar ras dkar ser gang rung gis bkab la tshon skud kyis bcings pa stegs bu'i dbus su gzhag mdun du 'bul gtor dkar zlum dang*/ byang shar nas brtsams te mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas skor du bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang skyabs sems nas bzung gdan bsdu ba'i bar bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ khrus bum rnam 'joms sogs kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du bsgrub pa'am/ gzungs sgrub mdor bsdus sam/ sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis chu dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab/ bum pa rnams la dmigs te sbyong ba gsum spyi ltar la bka' bsgo ba'i tshe/ deng 'dir gter chen po'i bum pa bzang po bsgrub pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i sogs kha sgyur dang*/ khrus gsol rgyas grangs gsog gi tshe sbyong khrus 'di thun dang po ma gtogs gzhan la mi dgos/ bsdus gang rigs spyi ltar bya/ de nas bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ rin po che dang 'bru bcud zas nor sogs lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags rgyas sbyang ba ni thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas yo byad ma dag pa rnams sbyangs te skyon thams cad dang bral bar bsam/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel ba ni/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i tshigs bar ma rnams bcag pa dpral bar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/

zhes pas mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i yo byad kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par bsam/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags rgyas bsgyur ba ni/ thal mo sbyar ba'i kha gyen du phye ste mthe bong bsnol la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas rdzas rnams 'phags pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud la zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed cing sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag zhi bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags rgyas spyod par dbang ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng g.yon rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pa'i 'phags pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i sprin mtha' yas pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi dbang po lnga'i spyod yul 'dod pa'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung bar bsam/ ye shes skar mda'i sngags rgyas thob par bya ba ni/ g.yas khu tshur bcangs pa snying gar gzhag g.yon mthe bong lag mthil du bzhag pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ dzñā na a wa lo ki te/ na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ zhes pas lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa 'phags pa rnams la phul bas mnyes shing sems can rnams yod byad la rgyal pham dang rtsod pa med par so so'i mos pa bzhin thob par bsam/ dbang bsgyur 'khor lo'am/ lha mgon spyi'i sngags rgyas dbang du bya ba ni/ sor mo nang du bsnol ba'i rdo rje bsdams pa las/ mthe bong gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs la/ na mas+sa man+ta bud+dha nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bha ñdza ti ma hā sa ma ya swā hā/ zhes pas mgron thams cad kyang dam tshig gi dbang gis bdag la 'go zhing phan pa dang bde ba'i phrin las 'ba' zhig sgrub cing*/

sems can gyi don yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzad par bsams te/ sngags brjod pa dang bstun phyag rgya gnas so sor bskor te phyogs bcur bstan pa'i mos pa bya/ bsdu na/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas brlab/ de lta bu'i bum pa'i stod kyi char pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig gser btso ma'i mdog can/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal te/ dpal 'byor gyi bde bas tshim pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ mchod yul rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*/ brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud ma lus pa tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i gter chen po'i bum pa bzang po bsnams pa/ dar sngon po'i sha 'gag dkar po'i stod g.yogs/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i smad g.yogs rnams dang nor bu rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dzam+bha la dang dpal chen mo sogs mdza' ba'i skye 'gro yid 'phrog pa'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig ser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo nor rgyun ma la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bum pa'i lha la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso 'khor thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ spro na tshigs bcad dang*/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bcas dbul/ rgyas par byed na 'dod yon lnga/ rin chen bdun/ gos zung rnams spyi ltar dang*/ maṇ+ḍal bcas dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung sogs bstod pa dang*/ me tog dang bcas thal mo 'dud pa'i rgyas tshigs mtshams rnams su me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ dpal mo dbyig gi dbang phyug sogs 'dod gsol rnams phan bde'i sprin phung ltar bya/ grangs gsog lta bu'i tshe shin tu bsdu dgos byung na/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ bcom ldan 'das mas sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ gang ltar yang gzungs thag blangs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal dang bral bar byas/ snod bcud srid zhi'i dge mtshan legs tshogs dpal yon dwangs bcud ma lus pa bsdus te mdun gyi bum pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams la thim pas 'dod rgu thams cad yid bzhin du 'byung ba'i gter chen po'i bum pa bzang por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ shrī ba su ni dhā na k+ṣe tre swā hā/ zhes gtso bor bzla zhing*/ spro na gzungs mdo'ang bklag cing gzungs ci nus bzla/ thun bsdu ba ni gtang rag gi slad du mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ mchod bstod dang 'dod gsol mdor bsdus bya/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin rlabs 'bul ba dang mchod bstod 'dod gsol rnams gong gi bris sku sgrub pa'i skabs ltar bya/

rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'i me tog thogs te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs brtan bzhugs spyi ltar la/ bye brag tu gter chen po'i bum pa bzang po 'di nyid la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha mo nor rgyun ma 'khor dang bcas pa ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad la log pa'i 'tsho ba ma yin pa'i chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes sam/ bsdu na/ 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu// zhes sogs brjod/ gang ltar yang su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang ye dharmā mang du bzla zhing me tog 'thor/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung ba dang*/ bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// bum pa mang po sgrub pa'i tshe grangs gsog na/ bdag bskyed tshar gcig gis 'thus/ bum pa bsang sbyangs nas brtan bzhugs bar bskyar/ de ltar thun bzhi sogs su bcad nas legs par bsgrubs pa'i rjes bang mdzod dang*/ khyim gyi phug gam/ zhing dang phyugs lhas kyi gong sogs gtsang zhing yid dang mthun pa'i sar bkur sti dang bcas spyan drangs la sba zhing*/ de'i tshe'ang byung na cho ga tshar gcig bskyar/ ma grub na brtan bzhugs shis brjod rgyas par byas kyang rung ngo*// 'di ni rgyud sde rnams nas bum pa bzang po'i dngos grub bsgrub par gsungs pa dang rjes su mthun zhing*/ gzungs las/ nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gi khyim na yod de/ sogs nas/ de la yun ring po'i don dang*/ phan pa dang*/ dge ba dang*/ grub pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ lo legs par 'gyur ro// zhes gzungs sngags gang du bzhugs pas phan yon rgya cher 'byung bar gsungs pa'ang 'di lta bu'i cho ga la brten nas 'thob par 'gyur bas mtshon 'phral dang yun du dge mtshan gyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par 'gyur ba nyid do// dpal ldan 'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i// gdams zab rdzogs ldan sprin phung las// dge legs 'dod rgu'i char phab pas// 'gro kun phan bdes 'byor gyur cig

/ces pa'ang gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rgya gzhung dang bod gzhung gi yi ge rnying pa ci rigs pa thos shing mthong ba rnams kyi dgongs don ma 'khrul bar phyogs gcig tu sdeb pa po ni/ bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas sbyar ba'i dge bas mtha' yas pa'i yid can thams cad chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la 'dod rgur longs spyod cing*/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la goms pas snod bcud kyi dpal 'byor thams cad ngang gis 'phel ba dang*/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rin po che der 'dzin dang bcas pa'ang rnyed pa dang bkur sti dang bcas yun ring du gnas shing*/ mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la dbang 'byor pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba dā shre yo bha ba tu// ༈ /dpal lha mo nor rgyun ma la bstod pa phan bde'i sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma// dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma// bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la 'dud// 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa'i sprin phung 'khrigs pa'i gzhir// sna tshogs pad+ma'i ze'u 'brus legs bsten pa'i// chu shel dkyil 'khor steng na rab rtsen ma// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sku gser gyi lhun po ltar mdzes shing*// thabs dang shes rab phyag gis legs brgyan nas// 'gro la zad med gter chen stsol mdzad ma// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /phyag g.yas mchog sbyin 'byor pa'i dpal ster zhing*// g.yon pas 'bras snye rin chen bum bzang gis// phun tshogs dbyig gi gru char 'bebs mdzad ma// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor 'dzum pa'i 'od zer can// yangs pa'i spyan gyis 'gro la legs gzigs ma// mdzes pa'i zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi// mthing mdog sha 'gag dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*// dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i smad dkris can// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dpag yas nor bu rin chen las grub pa'i// dbu rgyan mgul rgyan mdzes pa'i rna cha g.yo// phyag zhabs rin chen gdu bus nyer mdzes ma// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// pad+ma rā ga spug dang karke ta// chu shel la sogs phreng ba'i do shal can// mu tig se mo do yis legs spras ma// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gsung gi chu 'dzin shin tu stug po las// dam chos bdud rtsi'i nor gyi rgyun phab ste// dad pa lteng ka'i bang mdzod 'gengs mdzad ma// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi thugs ni ston ka'i zla ba ltar// yon tan 'od zer dpag med rab rgyas nas// nyes pa'i mun pa ma lus drung 'byin ma// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon gyi sbyin pa'i dpal las legs grub cing*// mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes nas// 'gro ba'i dbul phongs ma lus zhi mdzad ma// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis khyed kyi mtshan tsam dran pas kyang*// yid la mngon 'dod 'bras bu mchog stsol zhing*// ser sna che ba'i nyes tshogs zhi mdzad ma// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin gter 'chang rmugs 'dzin dbang po dang*// dpal chen ma sogs 'dzad med 'byor pa'i bdag

/mdza' ba'i skye 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba'i// bcom ldan nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ ༈ /dpal mo dbyig gi dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// snyan grags tshe dang dam chos rin chen gter// cho ga
